vetSays.line: 🛡️ Olivia, Scott, Nisrine and Yara met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Olivia, Scott, Nisrine, Yara are hurt.
🛡️ Juan, Nisrine and Yara met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Juan, Nisrine, Yara are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Olivia, Scott and Yara met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Olivia, Scott, Yara are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Juan just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Olivia, Scott, Juan and Nisrine met them at the door — 4 put down. Olivia, Juan, Nisrine are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ingrid just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Olivia just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Olivia, Scott, Juan, Nisrine and Greivis met them at the door — 2 put down, 3 barely walked away. Olivia, Scott, Juan, Nisrine, Greivis are hurt.
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Greivis just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nora just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ THE WAR PATH — The System pauses — actually pausing. It keeps a list of every tooth pulled, and for once it reads the list instead of the press release. They faced Big Big and lived to sit here. They faced The Suburb and lived to sit here. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans).

regDeaths.name: the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
a heron that isn't quite there when you look at it
a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
